changes.request_failure_correlation: Every failure carriesSHA256 of the request Authorization header, or no digest for an unauthenticated request. No additional raw token is captured by the completion lambda.
changes.window_admission: Original connection and current credential digest are checked before changing busy/sign-in/UI/credential state. Application-owned provisioning failures use the same handler.
changes.managed_owner_rejection: Matching managed-owner401 reports recovery unavailable and hides the rejected sign-in code while preserving the sole saved owner credential.
changes.legacy_revocation: Matching legacy login401 still removes the revoked credential and sign-in code.
changes.transport_injection: Socket-free real-client reply ordering and actual widget failure paths; production continues to use its ownQNAM and per-request manual redirects.

tests.initial_behavioral_red: red-ctest: client passed, actual window failed on delayed obsolete401 and managed-owner credential deletion. Context transport/harness added before the guard fix.
tests.initial_harness_compile_failure: red-build failed the explicit HAVE_KEYCHAIN safeguard; separate session-only credential object then compiled successfully before behavioral red. No test keyring writes were performed.
tests.intermediate_fixture_failure: fixed-ctest failed the composed HTTP test because its running-state fixture also supplied a pendingQR URL. Fixture corrected to needs_login before final green/mutations.
window_cases: 16 obsolete authenticated failures: legacy/managed x unauthorized/network error x login/provision/sharing/signout
Real delayedHTTP401 after production onProvisioned delivery preserves new token/session-store entry/new QR
Matching managed login401 preserves token/store and hides rejected QR
Retired original connection cannot change busy/token/QR
Public unauthenticated status error remains visible without clearing token
tests.test_credentials: Production token-store implementation compiled withoutHAVE_KEYCHAIN into a separate test object; runtime assertion refuses real persistent keyring access. All bearer values are synthetic. No sockets or radio peer.
tests.log_rule_notes: 12 pre-existing moved source-line citations outside TailnetShim source; no log wording changed here.

limitations: Deterministic injected callback/HTTP order in the production window and real client, not a live revocation of the installed owner token.
Persistent OS keychain implementations/platforms and sanitizer lifetimes remain final qualification gates.

A credential fingerprint correlates a request with a token; it does not identify an operation epoch that reused the same token. Successful delayed login/status replies and managed same-token cancel/rejoin ordering remain a separate unqualified P4 item.
Actual tailnet account approval/routing/expiry, lost-owner recovery/rotation, minimum6300 and the full P1-P10 RF/fault/installer/release gates remain open.
Existing d1desktop/43runtime5W/10W RF evidence remains under its original pins; the newly built desktop has not been deployed or RF-qualified.
